node.statement: Row transfer and completion: under the same universal threshold and constant, every n>=1 and W in M_n tensor S_{Q,P} satisfy ||(Ha^Q_{Q,P})_n(W)-J_{Q,P,n}(W)||_op<=C_* e ||W||; taking suprema over nonzero Z and W proves the root with C_sp=C_* and the common positive threshold e_sp.
